# Say who you are

For **Maya Lindqvist**, Reviewer; reads a colleague's HTML report or deck and says what she thinks. Designed.

## Goal
Maya's comments carry her name instead of an animal, with no account and no sign-in.

## Steps

### Add your name
![Add your name](../../references/screens/jny-say-who-you-are/add-your-name--default--desktop--dark.png)

Wording (text the mock does not show as it is; `{…}` is what the data fills in):
- "{name}": the name she gave, on the row, on every card and in the copied Markdown.
- "Add name": the row's action until a name is given; the edit mark afterwards.

- **FR-011** A reviewer can add or change their name in place on the menu's first row (and on the compose card), with Enter or leaving the field saving and Esc cancelling, and the name shows on every card and in every copy.

<details><summary>Acceptance criteria (3)</summary>

- **AC-add-your-name-1** (FR-011): Given the menu open, when Maya chooses the edit mark, then the first row becomes a text field holding her current name with the cursor at its end, and the menu stays open. _(proven in the prototype, 2026-11-10)_
- **AC-add-your-name-2** (FR-011): Given the field, when she types a name and presses Enter, then the row shows that name with the edit mark, and every card on the page shows it. _(proven in the prototype, 2026-11-10)_
- **AC-add-your-name-3** (FR-011): Given the field, when she presses Esc, then the row shows the name she had and the menu is still open. _(proven in the prototype, 2026-11-10)_

</details>
